name: Landscaping & irrigation
notes: Turf and seeding prices come from DOT weighted-average bid prices (very large highway quantities, so they represent the floor). Planted landscape, trees and irrigation have no DOT equivalent; they are derived using consumer cost guides (Fixr, low confidence, residential scale) as bounds and a commercial assembly in each method.

items.name: Commercial landscaping with irrigation (shrubs, groundcover, mulch, turf, drip/spray irrigation) - per SF of landscaped area

cost.method: Fixr residential landscaping $5-$20/SF (e6) brackets the top; commercial code-minimum landscape beds are less dense. Assembly per SF of landscaped area: ~50% turf at ~$1/SF (sod, e1/e4) + ~50% shrub/groundcover beds at ~$7-$10/SF (plants, soil prep, mulch, edging) + irrigation ~$1.25-$2/SF (controller, valves, spray/drip) = ~$5.25-$7.00; mid $6. Low $3 = mostly turf/xeriscape with minimal irrigation; high $12 = dense ornamental beds, specimen plantings, enhanced irrigation.

items.notes: Trees counted separately (tree-installed). Apply to landscaped area only (typically 15-25% of a commercial site).

items.name: Sod, installed (incl. fine grading/soil prep allowance)

cost.method: DOT: FDOT performance turf, sod $4.37/SY = $0.49/SF on 6.3M SY (e1); ArDOT solid sodding $5.08/SY = $0.56/SF (e2); MDT sodding $36.16/SY = $4.02/SF on only 958 SY (e3, small-quantity outlier). Consumer: Fixr $0.85-$1.75/SF installed (e4). Mid $0.95 = between DOT large-quantity floor and the Fixr midpoint ($1.30), weighted toward commercial quantities; low = DOT; high = Fixr top.

items.notes: Bermuda/St. Augustine/fescue by region. Seeding/hydroseed is far cheaper (seeding).

items.name: Seeding / hydroseeding with mulch (permanent stabilization)

cost.method: ArDOT seeding $1,365.47/acre (151.8 ac, e7) and mulch cover $1,038.62/acre; MDT seeding area no. 1 $769.04/acre (e8). Mid $1,400 ~ ArDOT seeding; low = MDT; high = hydroseed with bonded fiber matrix on small areas.

items.notes: For detention pond banks, open space, future-phase pads.

items.name: Tree, installed (2-3" caliper / 15-30 gal, incl. staking and 1-yr warranty)

cost.method: Fixr: national average $350 per planted tree (range $200-$550); medium 5-9 ft trees $250-$650 and large 10-19 ft $650-$2,000 (e5). Commercial code trees are typically 2-3" caliper (≈10-14 ft), so mid $600 sits between Fixr's medium and large classes; low = 15-gal/1.5" caliper; high = 3-4" caliper or 30-36" box.

items.notes: Parking-lot islands commonly require 1 tree per 8-12 spaces; street trees ~1 per 30-40 LF of frontage.

items.name: Landscaping & irrigation, all-in per gross site acre (typical commercial site)

cost.method: Per gross acre: landscaped share 15-25% x 43,560 SF = 6,500-10,900 SF; at landscaping-irrigation-commercial $3-$6/SF = $20k-$65k; plus trees (~10-20 per acre at $600 = $6k-$12k). Mid: 20% x 43,560 x $4.50 (blended with lower-cost turf areas) + 15 trees x $600 = ~$48k, rounded to $45k. Low $20k = turf-dominant; high $90k = 25% landscaped at $7.50/SF plus 20 trees. Fixr residential per-acre figures ($2k-$4k basic turf; ~$10k+ fully landscaped acre, e6) are below commercial practice and used only as a floor check.

items.notes: Use when landscaping is not itemized. Already included in site-development-light; do not stack.
